# ProfileOS
> The 100% Offline, Privacy-First Digital Profile & Identity Manager for Android.
> Developed by PrintionUp Studio (Founded by Abuzar Gaffari).
> Official Website: https://abuzargaffaris.github.io/ProfileOS/
> Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.printionupstudio.profileos
> Package Name: com.printionupstudio.profileos

## Summary
ProfileOS is an Android utility application that stores, organizes, and shares all your digital identities, social media handles, portfolio links, and messaging contacts entirely offline. Built on a local-first SQLite Room database, ProfileOS eliminates cloud sync latency (delivering <3ms response times), protects users from surveillance with zero telemetry, and provides rapid 4-directional swipe gestures and instant optical QR codes for in-person and digital networking.

## Core Differentiators & Architecture
- **100% Local-First & Zero Telemetry**: All data resides in an on-device SQLite database managed by Android Jetpack Room. No user accounts, no passwords, no servers, no Google Analytics, no Firebase Analytics, and zero third-party trackers.
- **4-Directional Swipe Shortcuts**:
  - Swipe Right: Instantly copies raw handle or normalized URL to clipboard with a crisp 15ms haptic confirmation pulse.
  - Swipe Left: Launches Smart Share Sheet with customized dynamic templates ({platform}, {handle}, {url}, {category}).
  - Swipe Up / Double-Tap: Expands high-contrast vector QR code modal with automatic screen brightness boost for instant optical scanning in low light.
  - Long-Press / Tap: Deep links directly into the native target mobile app installed on the device.
- **Privacy Shield Mode**: Masks usernames with dot characters on screen (e.g., @al•••••er) to protect sensitive credentials from shoulder-surfing during screen recordings and public presentations.
- **229+ Pre-Configured Platforms**: Instant handle normalization and color-coded presets for GitHub, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Instagram, YouTube, Discord, Threads, Mastodon, Bluesky, Telegram, WhatsApp, Behance, Dribbble, Substack, Medium, Figma, and hundreds more, plus custom link support with local favicon caching.
- **Spaces (Contextual Identity Segmentation)**: Easily partition profiles into distinct spaces (Personal, Work, Creator, Freelance, Dev) to prevent context collapse.
- **Two-Layer Backup & Portability**:
  - Layer 1: Automatic Android Auto Backup for Apps (25MB free encrypted quota tied to Google Account lock credentials).
  - Layer 2: On-demand Manual Export into universal JSON and Markdown formats for permanent data sovereignty, human readability, and developer script automation.
